"""Every order in a quarter, one line each, as CSV."""


class QuarterlyExport:
    def __init__(self, orders):
        self.orders = list(orders)

    def to_csv(self):
        lines = ["order_id,items,total"]
        for order in self.orders:
            total = sum(order["prices"])
            lines.append(f"{order['id']},{len(order['prices'])},{total}")
        return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

"""Sales per customer, for the sales team."""


class SalesReport:
    def __init__(self, orders):
        self.orders = list(orders)

    def lines(self):
        totals = {}
        for order in self.orders:
            totals[order["customer"]] = totals.get(order["customer"], 0) + sum(order["prices"])
        return [f"{customer}: {total}" for customer, total in sorted(totals.items())]

import unittest

from csv_export import to_csv
from orders_page import OrdersPage
from quarterly_export import QuarterlyExport

ORDERS = [
    {"id": 2, "customer": "Okafor", "total": 40.0},
    {"id": 1, "customer": "Lindqvist", "total": 12.5},
]


class OrdersPageTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_refresh_button_sorts_the_table(self):
        page = OrdersPage(ORDERS)
        page.click("refresh")
        self.assertEqual([order["id"] for order in page.shown], [1, 2])

    def test_export_writes_one_download(self):
        page = OrdersPage(ORDERS)
        page.export()
        self.assertEqual(len(page.downloads), 1)

    def test_csv_has_a_header_and_a_row_per_order(self):
        self.assertEqual(to_csv(ORDERS).splitlines(), ["id,customer,total", "2,Okafor,40.00", "1,Lindqvist,12.50"])


class QuarterlyExportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_one_line_per_order_after_the_header(self):
        export = QuarterlyExport([{"id": "A1", "prices": [10, 5]}, {"id": "A2", "prices": [7]}])
        self.assertEqual(export.to_csv().splitlines()[0], "order_id,items,total")
        self.assertEqual(len(export.to_csv().splitlines()), 3)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest

from reconciliation_worker import ReconciliationWorker
from sales_report import SalesReport


class Store:
    def __init__(self, order_ids, payments):
        self._order_ids = set(order_ids)
        self._payments = payments

    def order_ids(self):
        return self._order_ids

    def payments(self, day):
        return [payment for payment in self._payments if payment["day"] == day]


class ReconciliationWorkerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_counts_payments_that_match_no_order(self):
        store = Store({"o1"}, [{"id": "p1", "order_id": "o1", "day": "2026-03-01"},
                               {"id": "p2", "order_id": "o9", "day": "2026-03-01"}])
        self.assertEqual(ReconciliationWorker(store).run("2026-03-01"), 1)

    def test_only_the_days_payments_count(self):
        store = Store(set(), [{"id": "p1", "order_id": "o9", "day": "2026-03-02"}])
        self.assertEqual(ReconciliationWorker(store).run("2026-03-01"), 0)


class SalesReportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_one_line_per_customer_in_name_order(self):
        report = SalesReport([{"customer": "Okafor", "prices": [4]}, {"customer": "Lindqvist", "prices": [2]}])
        self.assertEqual(report.lines(), ["Lindqvist: 2", "Okafor: 4"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
